note: The trend watch's watch lists (scripts/scan-trending-cats.mjs), edited by hand. topAccounts: X handles without @ of the accounts that move memecoins, searched on every other "big" lens turn; bigAccounts: famous people and companies with many followers (no politicians: politics is sensitive), searched a chunk at a time on the other "big" turns (the "big" lens is every other rotation run); besides both lists, any account with at least 1,000,000 followers counts as big when a search finds its cat post, any post of theirs that mentions a cat counts, with or without a picture, and one with no cat's name in it is listed as a signal. figures: famous cat characters and cat memes that are not in the sanctuary yet, searched on the "figures" lens; a post that names one is read as that cat. name is the canonical name; aliases also match (whole words, "and" also matches "&"; a one-word name in any case, a name of several words only written with its capitals, so "Grumpy Cat" but not "my grumpy cat"; avoid aliases that are everyday phrases, like "tom cat" or "spinning cat", or a film with several cats in it); matchOnlyAliases: the name alone is too common a word to match (Tom, Duchess), so only the aliases do; needsCatWord: the post must also say cat, and the name is searched with a cat word (the name is shared with people, like Andrew Garfield); kind: cartoon, fiction, real or meme (read as cartoon); ticker: optional, otherwise made from the name. A figure whose name or alias is already a sanctuary cat is skipped, and so is a name or alias found inside a sanctuary cat's name ("Tom Cat" is in "Talking Tom Cat") (tests/trendwatch.test.mjs checks this file against data/adoptables.json and data/planned.json). Queries are split so each stays within X's 512 characters. Optional, for the sanctuary's launcher (scripts/lib/launcher.mjs): look (20 to 600 characters: how the cat looks, for its card and its 3D model), coat ({ base, second, pattern, eyes } in the site's coat words), owner (who the fan tribute names) and category (an adoptable category); a figure the launcher launches moves into the sanctuary and leaves this list.
memeAccountsNote: Cat-meme accounts (the owner's kind of coin: a fresh viral cat photo or clip named after its moment, like Foot Cat or Wiwiwi Cat). Every post of theirs with a picture is searched, no cat word needed, on the big lens's turns; Claude reads the picture and may give a cat with no name of its own a meme name. A post still needs to be viral or rising, and its picture may not show a person's face. X handles without @, edited by hand.
linksNote: Ties for the automatic launcher's venue (scripts/lib/venues-routing.mjs chooseVenue), edited by hand: the owner may add, change or remove any. A cat tied to a company that has a tokenized stock launches on StonkFun priced in that stock; a cat tied to a coin pump.fun offers as a quote launches on pump.fun priced in that coin; any other cat launches on pump.fun priced in SOL. accountLinks: an X handle without @ (a company; watched or not: any big account a search finds counts) and its tie, { "stock": a symbol of assets/collection.js STOCK_PAIRS } or { "pumpQuote": { "symbol", "mint" } }; it holds for that account's cat posts. A figure may carry the same "stock" or "pumpQuote" field; it holds when the post's cat is that figure, and is tried before the account's. Seeded only with the watched companies whose stock is one of the 93 stock pairs (checked in tests/venues-routing.test.mjs); people are not tied. OpenAI is tied to tOpenAI, the Tessera token, because the OPENAI PreStock already has a planned cat, and a stock pair that already has a sanctuary cat is not used again (one cat per pair): such a cat launches in SOL instead (today only tOpenAI and tKalshi are free). No pumpQuote is seeded: a coin is used only when data/pump-quotes.json lists it and the owner opts in, for example { "pumpQuote": { "symbol": "PUMP", "mint": "<its mint>" } } on pumpdotfun.
